summary: B11's board block on every world cell and B12's one 3D scene graph at three distances: world cells tinted by control with routes drawn by risk, forces and the party as miniatures on the tethers, and the room distance showing a cell's footprint, spawn sockets and exits.

coordination.notes: Content owns the room, the board draws it, the snapshot says what is true now. No AuthoredCell field was added: AuthoredCell does not deny unknown fields and the B6/B7 equality test in godot-rust/tests/authored_world.rs builds the wire cell field by field rather than mirroring a whole record, so the board block reaches Godot and stops there. godot_bridge.rs took exactly one read-only hunk, a `forces` array on the state dictionary (id, faction, cell, next cell, progress) plus its one `result.set`; no strength, readiness, supply or composition crosses that boundary. tools/src/validate.mjs took two hunks for one feature: the board_footprint_registry branch in the presentation dispatch (the footprint table's owner) and one block after it holding every cell's board against that table. game/scripts/world/expedition_* is P7's and was not touched; the 2D ExpeditionRouteBoard stays the owner of the 2D board this round and a later card retires it against this one rather than a fork. P2 had not pushed a branch, so BoardCamera and BoardBlockout.clay carry local fixed-isometric angles and a local StandardMaterial3D, both marked in place as P2's to absorb; SetpieceMeshFactory was reused rather than duplicated. blocked: needs decision -- O3 (the six standard footprints, marked in content and required to be marked by the validator) and O1 (the encounter lens: EncounterLens opens the existing battle screen and says the decision is Open). blocked: needs a bridge verb -- no #[func] raises, dispatches or ticks a force, so through the live bridge the island's `forces` array is always empty; game/tests/board_verification_campaign.gd puts one marching force into the live campaign through the bridge's own save_json/load_json round trip and says in place that it must be deleted the day such a verb lands.
